_comment: models 站成员备注（note）的英文。2026-10-04。键= `<seriesCode>|<repo名>`。
_rules: 0) 这些备注包含**法律判断**（「许可为 other，须读发布页原文」）—— 强度必须保留，不能软化成 note。
1) 数字与许可证标识原样（MIT / apache-2.0 / 702 万 → 7.02M）。
2) 产品名与型号原样保留。
gemma-4|gemma-4-26B-A4B-it: MoE: 26B total parameters but only about 4B activate per token, so it runs at close to 4B-dense speed.
gemma-4|gemma-4-31B-it: The heaviest of the sizes in this series.
gemma-4|gemma-4-E4B-it: A small size, covered by 34 quantisations — the least resource-hungry entry point for local deployment.
glm-5|GLM-5.3: Licence is "other"; you must read the release page text before using it.
glm-5|GLM-5.3-Flash: MIT licensed — legally the cleanest GLM option for local deployment.
gpt-oss|gpt-oss-20b: apache-2.0, 6.74M downloads. Not the newest generation, but a mature quantisation ecosystem and the cleanest licence.
kimi-k3|Kimi-K3: Licence is "other"; you must read the release page text before using it.
minicpm5|MiniCPM5-2B: The model authors publish GGUF themselves (openbmb, 249k downloads).
qwen3-8|Qwen3.8-27B: apache-2.0, 7.02M downloads. The baseline model this site's quantisation comparison uses.
qwen3-8|Qwen3.8-Flash-Next: Licence is "other"; read the licence text on the release page before use.
deepseek-v4|DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash: MIT licensed, 20 third-party quantisation repos; antirez alone accounts for 1.67M downloads.
ornith-1-5|Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B: MIT licensed, 59 GGUF repos (58 third-party); the vendor also publishes its own GGUF.
ornith-1-5|Ornith-1.5-9B: MIT licensed, 43 GGUF repos; the first-party GGUF alone has 5.15M downloads — the highest single repo among the series listed here.
muse-glimmer|Muse-Glimmer-30B: apache-2.0, 61 GGUF repos (60 third-party), covered by all three of unsloth, LM Studio and bartowski.
kat-coder|KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev: apache-2.0, 34 third-party quantisation repos (mudler 974k / bartowski 279k). The base repo itself has modest downloads, but quantisation uptake is concentrated.
laguna|Laguna-XS-2.1: Licensed OpenMDW-1.1 (not apache or mit) — read the original licence on the release page before use. 20 GGUF repos; the vendor publishes its own GGUF too.
